mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_student_wechat_binding WHERE student_id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, student_user.username AS student_account, binding.id AS binding_id, binding.bound_at FROM edu_parent_student relationship JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = relationship.student_id JOIN sys_user student_user ON student_user.id = student.student_user_id LEFT JOIN auth_student_wechat_binding binding ON binding.student_id = student.id WHERE relationship.parent_user_id = #{parentUserId} AND relationship.relation_role = 'PRIMARY_GUARDIAN' AND relationship.status = 'ACTIVE' AND relationship.primary_scope_key = 'PRIMARY' AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_user.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id
